title: T970 UFS single NOP (no SCSI/storage writes)
conclusion: One NOP OUT/IN completed successfully through the experimental DMA path; OCS and protocol checks passed, protected state unchanged, no global fault and no CB0 FSR change.
limits: No SCSI data payload, LUN identification, capacity, partition or block read was tested.
Both candidate routes were installed together; this does not identify which SID carried the successful transfer or prove both were exercised.
A single successful NOP does not establish sustained transport stability or root-volume readiness.
FAR is not interpreted as a new fault because GFSR and CB0 FSR showed no new error.
next_action: Bounded LUN identification and capacity/data-in validation, followed by known-block reads and comparison with captured GPT geometry. No storage writes.
